title: Cold Case Files: Dead West
description:
S01 E02 — Thou Shalt Not Kill
A killer shoots Christian ranch hand, Dan Lavigne, on his porch in Montana, 2002; deputies find no shortage of suspects; what follows is an eight-year quest for justice that stretches across three states.

title: Cold Case Files: Dead West
description:
S01 E05 — Lovers, Lies and Canyon Murder
It takes 20 years and a new technology to finally solve the murder of Carol Murphy, who was discovered by hikers slain in the woods in 1987.

title: Cold Case Files: Dead West
description:
S01 E01 — Mystery In Cuero
When Pam Shelly, 31, is found in her Cuero, Texas bathroom with a fatal gunshot wound to the head, her death is initially ruled a suicide. Yet, a tenacious investigator's instincts and his suspicion of foul play eventually cracks the case wide open.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E01 — Aileen Wuornos: The Damsel of Death
In 1989, Richard Mallory is found shot dead in the brush off the side of a Florida highway, just the first of seven murdered men found in a similar setting; their predator is Aileen Wuornos, a woman fleeing from her troubled past.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E03 — Danny Rolling: The Gainesville Ripper
Known primarily for the murders of University of Florida students, a man's first murders were in his hometown of Shreveport, La.; the man dreamed of having a loving family as an adult, but his dark fantasies drove him to destroy a family instead.

title: First Blood
description:
S01 E02 — Robert Hansen: The Butcher Baker
Before he hunted down his first victim in the wilds of Alaska, Robert Hansen was a successful businessman with a family in Anchorage, but his intense feelings would build into a dark desire to exert the ultimate control over 17 victims.

title: Cold Case Files: Dead West
description:
S01 E06 — The Death of Lavender Doe
When a mystery woman's burning body appears in an oil field in 2006, the rural community of Kilgore and a determined Texas lawman show why not mess with the Lone Star State; it takes 13 years to ID this Lavender Doe and nab her callous killer.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E03 — Murder and the Missing Mom
Despite a massive search, a missing woman was never found; a private detective suggests that the missing woman's husband is responsible, and he is arrested.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E04 — The Pizza Delivery Murder
A single mom and pizza delivery driver was murdered on a late-night run for Dominos, and police arrested her former boyfriend.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E08 — A Mother's Secret
In 1993, a newborn baby's body is discovered; the coroner determines the baby had been born alive; after 25 years, and with the assistance of modern DNA techniques, Gail Eastwood-Ritchey is found guilty of murder and sentenced to life in prison.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E05 — Murder at the Beauty Salon
When a hairstylist fails to pick up her children for a planned celebration, she is reported missing by her ex-husband; investigators discover a bloody scene at the salon, but the hairstylist and her SUV are gone.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E11 — The Jazz Musician's Murder
Jazz trumpet player Scott Sessions fails to show up for a gig; his body is found a few days later, wrapped in plastic, partially burned and hidden in a forest; investigators trace his last known whereabouts to the residence of his new love interest.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E09 — Murder on County Road M
Todd Kendhammer calls 911 in a panic, describing a freak accident involving his wife; police are suspicious of Todd's responses in the interrogation room; forensic details from the autopsy report cast further doubt on his story.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E01 — The New Year's Eve Murder
Police body cam video captures the cries of an Army sergeant as she cradles her dying husband in her arms; despite the happy outward appearance of the young military couple, investigators soon accuse the wife of directing a murder-for-hire plot.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E04 — Allentown Massacre & The Copycat
Brothers become neo-Nazis in Allentown, Pa.; a young student, riveted by the Allentown killings, plots a murder.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E03 — Frenemies & the Reject
An ex-con gets jealous when a girl grows popular in school; a youngster with a violent, alcoholic mother shows signs of being a psychopath.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E03 — Crazy Love and Double Vision
A teen couple plan for careers in the military, but infidelity leads the lovers down a twisted path; a mother of twin daughters is found murdered in her Georgia home.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E08 — Peeping Theodore & The Six
A death row confession reveals the truth of what happened to a missing 8-year-old girl; a group of teenagers is obsessed with vampirism, devil worship and drugs.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E19 — Out of Control
Three teens decide to rob an auto parts store in Pensacola; a thief steals a gun from a flea market, robs a convenience store and abducts the cashier.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E05 — For Sandy & Poison Pal
After being bullied for their love, two girls conspire to commit murder; two teens fall for the same girl.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S03 E09 — Two Strikes & Hail Mary

title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
description:
S01 E04 — Horror in Starkville Mississippi
When Betty Jones and Kathryn Crigler are brutally attacked in a home invasion, the tiny community of Starkville, Mississippi, is left living in fear; decades pass, and a detective devotes himself to cracking the case using new technology.

title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
description:
S01 E02 — The Devil in Hammond
When a young mother, Selonia Reed, 26, is found murdered in her car, detectives turn over every rock in search of her killer; her case languishes for more than 30 years before justice is served.

title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
description:
S01 E03 — Lost Soul in Lafayette
When the body of free-spirited Bonnie Ruphard, 47, is spotted by a runner in Lafayette, Louisiana, police suspect domestic violence; the case sits for a decade until DNA places a sprawling Bayou family under the microscope for her murder.

title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
description:
S01 E06 — Monster in Bayou Pigeon
In 1991 Curtis "Cochise" Smith, 29, heads out for diapers in Plaquemine, Louisiana, and vanishes; twenty-five years later, a body surfaces in the bayou and Cochise's murder case reignites; a local with a long rap sheet becomes the prime suspect.

title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
description:
S01 E01 — A Trinity River Murder
When the supposed great-niece of Marilyn Monroe, Krystal Jean Baker, 13, appears dead beneath a bridge in Texas' Bayou Country, investigators are stumped; the quest to track down her killer will take investigators 14 years, and lead to a new law.

title: Cold Case Files: Murder in the Bayou
description:
S01 E05 — Evil in Cajun Country
The town of Alexandria is rocked when the body of Courtney Coco, 19, is found dumped 200 miles from home in Winnie; the case cools until a retired homicide detective turned podcaster discovers her killer hiding in plain sight.

title: Cold Case Files: Dead West
description:
S01 E04 — Murder in the City of Saints
The daughter of a woman who was murdered in her rare books store teams up with an investigator to bring her mother's killer to justice.

title: Butchers of the Bayou
description:
S01 E01
Charlotte Murray Pace, an LSU graduate, is found dead in her home on May 31, 2002, and the brutality of the crime scene reminds police of the unsolved case of Gina Wilson Green.

title: Butchers of the Bayou
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
The investigation focuses on a white man with a white pickup truck; in March 1994, Ann Bryan is found murdered in her home at the St. James Place retirement community; despite attempts to catch her killer, the case goes cold.

title: Butchers of the Bayou
description:
S01 E03 — Part 3
After Derrick Todd Lee is arrested, police are able to connect him to other cold cases; at the time, Baton Rouge, La., had approximately 60 unsolved cases of missing or murdered women in the area from the previous 10 years.

title: Butchers of the Bayou
description:
S01 E04
The tire track at the Donna Bennett Johnston crime scene provides police with a long list of potential suspects; detectives pore through the list until finally they show up at the house of Sean Vincent Gillis.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E03 — Phoenix Serial Shooter: Dale Hausner
Randy Hausner reveals how his brother terrorized the city of Phoenix in a killing spree; Randy meets with a shooting survivor and with the son of a man killed by his brother.
